sentences.cn_text: 当利亚姆·麦基于8月辞去美国银行总裁职务时，他的解释出人意料地坦率直接。
sentences.en_text: When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August, his explanation was surprisingly straight up.

sentences.cn_text: 他没有用通常那些含糊其辞的借口来掩饰离职，而是直截了当地表示自己离开是为了「追求经营一家公司的目标」。
sentences.en_text: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving “to pursue my goal of running a company.”

sentences.cn_text: 麦基说，公开宣布自己的抱负「完全是我自己的决定」。
sentences.en_text: Broadcasting his ambition was “very much my decision,” McGee says.

sentences.cn_text: 两周之内，他便首次与哈特福德金融服务集团董事会进行了会谈，该集团于9月29日任命他为首席执行官兼董事长。
sentences.en_text: Within two weeks, he was talking for the first time with the board of Hartford Financial Services Group, which named him CEO and chairman on September 29.

sentences.cn_text: 麦基表示，在没有确定下一个职位的情况下离职，给了他时间思考自己想要经营什么样的公司。
sentences.en_text: McGee says leaving without a position lined up gave him time to reflect on what kind of company he wanted to run.

sentences.cn_text: 这也向外界清晰地传递了他的职业抱负。
sentences.en_text: It also sent a clear message to the outside world about his aspirations.

sentences.cn_text: 而且麦基并非个例。
sentences.en_text: And McGee isn’t alone.

sentences.cn_text: 最近几周，雅芳和美国运通的二号高管相继辞职，给出的理由都是在寻找首席执行官职位。
sentences.en_text: In recent weeks the No. 2 executives at Avon and American Express quit with the explanation that they were looking for a CEO post.

sentences.cn_text: 随着董事会迫于股东压力而严格审查继任计划，那些未能获得提名的高管也可能希望另谋出路。
sentences.en_text: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don’t get the nod also may wish to move on.

sentences.cn_text: 动荡的商业环境也使得高级管理人员对模糊表态可能损害自身声誉这一点格外谨慎。
sentences.en_text: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.

sentences.cn_text: 随着经济复苏的初步迹象开始显现，副职高管可能更愿意在没有退路的情况下冒险跳槽。
sentences.en_text: As the first signs of recovery begin to take hold, deputy chiefs may be more willing to make the jump without a net.

sentences.cn_text: 据Liberum研究公司统计，第三季度首席执行官更替率较去年同期下降了23%，原因是紧张不安的董事会选择坚守现有领导层。
sentences.en_text: In the third quarter, CEO turnover was down 23% from a year ago as nervous boards stuck with the leaders they had, according to Liberum Research.

sentences.cn_text: 随着经济回暖，志向远大的领导者将迎来大量机会。
sentences.en_text: As the economy picks up, opportunities will abound for aspiring leaders.

sentences.cn_text: 辞去高级职位去寻找更好的机会，这一做法并不符合常规。
sentences.en_text: The decision to quit a senior position to look for a better one is unconventional.

sentences.cn_text: 多年来，高管和猎头公司一直遵循这样一条准则：最具吸引力的首席执行官候选人是那些必须被挖角的人。
sentences.en_text: For years executives and headhunters have adhered to the rule that the most attractive CEO candidates are the ones who must be poached.

sentences.cn_text: 光辉国际高级合伙人丹尼斯·凯里说：「我想不起在我经手的任何一次搜寻中，有哪个董事会没有要求我优先考察在任首席执行官。」
sentences.en_text: Says Korn/Ferry senior partner Dennis Carey: “I can’t think of a single search I’ve done where a board has not instructed me to look at sitting CEOs first.”

sentences.cn_text: 那些在没有工作保障的情况下跳槽的人，并非总能迅速获得高层职位。
sentences.en_text: Those who jumped without a job haven’t always landed in top positions quickly.

sentences.cn_text: 十年前，艾伦·马拉姆辞去纯果乐公司总裁职务，表示她想成为一名首席执行官。
sentences.en_text: Ellen Marram quit as chief of Tropicana a decade ago, saying she wanted to be a CEO.

sentences.cn_text: 一年之后，她才成为一家小型互联网大宗商品交易所的负责人。
sentences.en_text: It was a year before she became head of a tiny Internet-based commodities exchange.

sentences.cn_text: 罗伯特·威廉姆斯塔德于2005年带着成为首席执行官的雄心离开花旗集团。
sentences.en_text: Robert Willumstad left Citigroup in 2005 with ambitions to be a CEO.

sentences.cn_text: 三年后，他才在一家大型金融机构担任了该职位。
sentences.en_text: He finally took that post at a major financial institution three years later.

sentences.cn_text: 许多招聘人员表示，对于顶尖表现者而言，过去的那种耻辱感正在消退。
sentences.en_text: Many recruiters say the old disgrace is fading for top performers.

sentences.cn_text: 金融危机使得处于工作空档期或离开一份糟糕工作变得更容易被接受。一位猎头说：「传统观念认为留在原地更安全，但这一点已被彻底颠覆。受伤最深的恰恰是那些待得太久的人。」
sentences.en_text: The financial crisis has made it more acceptable to be between jobs or to leave a bad one. “The traditional rule was it’s safer to stay where you are, but that’s been fundamentally inverted,” says one headhunter. “The people who’ve been hurt the worst are those who’ve stayed too long.”

sentences.cn_text: 当麦基宣布离职时，他的态度最恰当的描述是____。
sentences.en_text: When McGee announced his departure, his manner can best be described as being ____

sentences.cn_text: 傲慢的
sentences.en_text: arrogant.

sentences.cn_text: 坦率的
sentences.en_text: frank.

sentences.cn_text: 以自我为中心的
sentences.en_text: self-centered.

sentences.cn_text: 冲动的
sentences.en_text: impulsive.

sentences.cn_text: 根据第二段，高级管理人员辞职可能是受到____的驱使。
sentences.en_text: According to Paragraph 2, senior executives' quitting may be spurred by ____

sentences.cn_text: 对更好财务状况的期待
sentences.en_text: their expectation of better financial status.

sentences.cn_text: 对私人生活进行反思的需要
sentences.en_text: their need to reflect on their private life.

sentences.cn_text: 与董事会的紧张关系
sentences.en_text: their strained relations with the boards.

sentences.cn_text: 对新职业目标的追求
sentences.en_text: their pursuit of new career goals.

sentences.cn_text: 「poached」一词(第4段)最可能的意思是____。
sentences.en_text: The word “poached” (Paragraph 4) most probably means ____

sentences.cn_text: 认可
sentences.en_text: approved of.

sentences.cn_text: 关注
sentences.en_text: attended to.

sentences.cn_text: 挖角
sentences.en_text: hunted for.

sentences.cn_text: 防范
sentences.en_text: guarded against.

sentences.cn_text: 从最后一段可以推断出____。
sentences.en_text: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ____

sentences.cn_text: 顶尖表现者过去常常固守自己的职位
sentences.en_text: top performers used to cling to their posts.

sentences.cn_text: 顶尖表现者的忠诚正在变得过时
sentences.en_text: loyalty of top performers is getting out-dated.

sentences.cn_text: 顶尖表现者更在意声誉
sentences.en_text: top performers care more about reputations.

sentences.cn_text: 坚守传统规则更为稳妥
sentences.en_text: it’s safer to stick to the traditional rules.

sentences.cn_text: 以下哪项是本文的最佳标题？
sentences.en_text: Which of the following is the best title for the text?

sentences.cn_text: 首席执行官：何去何从？
sentences.en_text: CEOs: Where to Go?

sentences.cn_text: 首席执行官：一路高升？
sentences.en_text: CEOs: All the Way Up?

sentences.cn_text: 高层管理者的无保障跳槽
sentences.en_text: Top Managers Jump without a Net

sentences.cn_text: 顶尖表现者的唯一出路
sentences.en_text: The Only Way Out for Top Performers
